collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an elder)

collection.description: An elder who once planned to paddle to the hazy far island is asked if they wish they had gone: say yes, or say you're not sure.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: When (subject) was young, (subject.he/she) planned to paddle out to the hazy island you can just see on the clearest days. (subject.He/she) talked about it all the time. (subject.He/she) never went. There was always work, or weather, or someone who needed (subject.him/her). Today (friend) asks, "Do you wish you'd gone?"

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Yes," says (subject). "Some days. Not most days." (subject.He/she) looks at the haze on the horizon. "I think it would have been beautiful. I think I'd have liked it. And I think I had a good life here instead." (friend) waits for the sad part. There isn't one. (subject) seems perfectly at peace with both halves.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "I don't know," says (subject). "Maybe it's better as an island I never reached. If I'd gone, it would just be a place. This way it's still the island." (friend) doesn't quite follow. (subject) laughs. "You will, when you're older. Or you won't. Either's fine."
